scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:convex
scripts.check:secrets: secret_pattern='(s''bp_|g''hp_|github_''pat_|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE'' KEY-----)'; if git grep -q -I -E "$secret_pattern" -- ':!pnpm-lock.yaml'; then echo 'Potential plaintext credential found in tracked files.' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.check: pnpm run check:secrets && pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run typecheck:convex && pnpm run lint:convex
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run verify:convex
